top_comments.author: @thomasg1111
top_comments.text: *Hollywood garbage, once again.* The sellers should simply counter with $825,000 and then walk out if rejected. There is nothing to fear from basless lawsuit threats nor criminal referrals. Every meth lab understands there is no hiding forever...so the criminal referral threat is merely a BLESSING because it removes that crutch from the meth business. The sellers now have every reason to relocate the lab, and THANK the negotiator for being that impetuous.

top_reply.author: @Mikey-Evermore
top_reply.text: Well, there are lawsuits on the books from buyers getting sick due to the house being contaminated with drugs and that not being disclosed in the documents and then proving that the sellers knew about it. These cases are also why it is suggested sellers do not meet the buyers because their reactions can be evidence in knowingly sold with certain conditions. Lying on disclosure documents can result in huge problems especially if there was earnest money getting paid before this scene.
